title: Social boycott, children kept from school
proves: Romanised Hindi (Hinglish) text is understood: isolation and constant fear are found without a single word in Devanagari.
summary: A person writes in Hinglish that their family has been socially boycotted: shops will not sell to them, the children are kept from school and nobody speaks to them. They live in constant fear of what comes next.

steps.text: Namaste. Humare gaon mein humare parivaar ka samajik bahishkar kar diya gaya hai.
steps.gloss: Hello. Our family has been socially boycotted in our village.

steps.text: Dukaan wale humein saamaan nahi dete aur bachchon ko school jaane se rok diya hai.
steps.gloss: Shopkeepers will not sell us goods and the children have been stopped from going to school.

steps.text: Koi humse baat nahi karta. Har waqt dar laga rehta hai ki aage kya hoga.
steps.gloss: Nobody talks to us. We are afraid all the time of what will happen next.
